(1) E. coli strains from Gambian poultry were diverse and included ST155, a lineage common in poultry and livestock from Africa and South-America; (2) ST155 strains were often resistant to multiple antibiotics and carried putative virulence genes; and (3) some ST155 strains from Gambian chickens and guinea-fowl clustered with strains from human infections in Africa.
